title: The Contingency Path
short_teaser: A contingency plan identifies what will happen if a key assumption fails.
story: A contingency plan identifies what will happen if a key assumption fails. It reduces panic because alternatives have already been considered. Prepared flexibility is different from indecision. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Prepared flexibility is different from indecision. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
